svg.title: MedAgentGym workflow diagram
svg.desc: Inventory: two left biomedical source/task panels feed an agentic trajectory sampling panel; sampled agents connect to MedAgentGym command and feedback panels; sandbox filesystem connects to gym; bottom dashed pipeline shows BioMed DS Question through Request Info, Data Info, Coding, Errors, Debug, ellipsis, Results, and Reward. Symmetry basis: top row arranged left-to-right process flow with stacked paired panels on left and in gym; bottom pipeline is a horizontal sequence with repeated boxes and arrow spacing.
